scope: What the Coder CLI prints on stdout for --json (and --stream-json, which these verbs read as the same flag): usage, ls, status, import, run|fork --detach, stop, replay, bench, plugins, credential, queue, daemon, jobs, host list, decide, policy, router, consent, remember, revise, forget and recall. Each output is compact JSON on one line that ends in a line feed (policy list keeps its file's line breaks; router prints a line an event); a body here is that output less its last line feed. Not here, because another row owns it: run, log and attach print session log lines (openagents.session.v1) and stream records (coder.observability.v2); route prints coder.route.v2; agents prints openagents.coder.agents.v1; session-read prints coder.session-reader.v1.
form: A member list gives an object's members in the order the writer writes them. A name that ends in ? is written only in the case its shape describes; every other member is always written. `top` is the output itself, or one row when the output is an array; any other list is named for the member that holds the object or the array of objects. Integers are decimal. Times that end in _us or are named `at` or `handled` are Unix microseconds; resets_at, asked_at and expires_at are Unix seconds.
captured: 2026-11-13, from the Coder CLI of this tree (coder/tui/coder.sh, built before the writers moved to the codec) in a throwaway home under /tmp/coder-c8, with a stand-in `hostname` that prints c8-host. Engines: echo, and psionic against coder/tui/local_model.py. No hosted model, login or network service was used: usage read the stand-in endpoints of coder/tui/smoke.py, ssh was a stand-in script, and the host list came from coder host against a local relay (nostr/relay) with throwaway browser keys. The second capture (decide, policy, router, consent, memory), the same day under /tmp/coder-c8x, was from the CLI built before those writers moved; recall's ranking replayed the recorded embeddings of coder/tui/fixtures/memory-replay with GW_REPLAY, and the Router's candidates met no System One key. decide has only its error outputs here: the repository has no recorded System One answer to a coder decide request, and System One's transport does not read GW_REPLAY; json-output.coax's own checks hold the decided form.

bench.command: coder bench SUITE --json; the same line is kept in ~/.openagents/coder/bench/SUITE-ID.json

job-handled.command: coder daemon --json, one line a job; the same line is the job's file in ~/.openagents/coder/daemon/done

beat.command: the daemon's heartbeat, ~/.openagents/coder/daemon/daemon.json; coder jobs --json prints it as its daemon object, with up

policy-result.command: coder policy add NAME ... --json, coder policy rm NAME --json

policy-list.command: coder policy list --json: the object after `sources` in ~/.openagents/coder/router/sources.json, with the file's line breaks

router-line.command: coder router --json, one line an event; the same lines are ~/.openagents/coder/router/log.jsonl

consent.command: coder consent [grant ENGINE --classes C [--days N] | revoke N] --json

when.usage.error: the agent's usage could not be read; windows is then empty
when.session.effect_outcome: state is running; its value is always unknown
when.session.cut: the log ends in a partial line of this many bytes, which was not read
when.stop.why: stopped is false; its value is always `not running`
when.stop.killed: the session did not stop within 10 s and its process was ended; always true
when.queued.dest: state is held: the job's machine did not answer
when.job-handled.session: the job started; else refused says why not
when.jobs.dest: the job is for another machine
when.jobs.exit: it failed there, with this exit status
when.decide.choice: System One decided; probability is then written too, with three decimals
when.decide.error: it did not; never with choice
when.policy-list.*: each member is a source's name and its entry; {} when there is none. An entry's members after authors are written only when set, and deliver, ci and send only as true. A sources.json a person wrote by hand is printed as it stands
when.router-line.kind: trigger: id, source, thread, fate, session when it has a worker, note (at most 2000 bytes) when there is one, at_us. batch: events, ms, decided, at_us. recall: id, sessions, hops, bytes
when.recall.score: ranked is true: the similarity to the query, in thousandths
when.recall.said_in: the fact names the session line it was said in; state is held, changed or gone
